This binding may influence the functional activity of Slc3a1, potentially affecting its interaction with Slc7a11. The final score of 0.7856 indicates a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, supported by the observed pathway interactions. The mechanism involves a series of molecular interactions where L-cystine modulates the transporter activity, which in turn may influence the function of Slc7a11. While the evidence is consistent, the exact nature of the interaction remains partially uncertain, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the role of L-cystine in regulating Slc7a11 function.
